request.initial_prompt: With this object I shall be obliged to retrace some of the steps which I have already taken, and to revert to topics which I have before discussed. I am aware that the reader may accuse me of repetition, but the importance of the matter which still remains to be treated is my excuse; I had rather say too much, than say too little to be thoroughly understood, and I prefer injuring the author to slighting the subject.

raw_segments.text: With this object I shall be obliged to retrace some of the steps which I have already taken, and to revert to topics which I have before discussed.
I am aware that the reader may accuse me of repetition, but the importance of the matter which still remains to be treated is my excuse.
I had rather say too much, than say too little to be thoroughly understood, and I prefer injuring the author to slighting the subject.
